we are a team of dedicated and passionate people, working together to improve health and well-being.
CT-guided high dose rate brachy therapy is a safe and effective method of local tumour control and palliation in patients with primary and metastatic lung cancer.
CT-HDRBT is safe and feasible for the treatment of primary and metastatic lung tumours, and it is associated with a high rate of local tumour control, with a low rate of complications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a CT-guided high dose rate brachytherapic ablation is safe, feasible and effective for primary and metastatic lung malignancies, regardless of the tumor diameter.

the combination of a high-dose-rate brachytherapy with a stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) is an effective treatment for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and can be performed with minimal toxicity and excellent local control rates.
